name: Young Curators
what_you_do: A free after school program. High school students write about art, learn about jobs in art and museums, and work together to put on an exhibit.
who_can_apply: High school students. The page gives no residency or other rules.
duration: Ends with an exhibition (2026 show ran Feb 27 to Apr 4, 2026)
deadline_text: Application dates not posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Not stated on the page. Contact SITE SANTA FE at info@sitesantafe.org or 505-989-1199.
